scope: Measured integration revisions; not a GPU qualification of the standalone master PR head.
component_formula: 100 * (1 - median(candidate_samples_us) / median(control_samples_us)); positive means lower candidate latency.
serving_formula: 100 * (mean(candidate_tokens_per_second) / mean(control_tokens_per_second) - 1); positive means higher candidate throughput.
source_state: Component candidates use git archives of the recorded commits. Serving uses immutable images built from recorded commit archives, without source overlays. Uncommitted worktree contents are excluded.

tp4.operating_mode: Single physical NVIDIA GB10 GPU in DGX Spark, P0 in every per-case before/after snapshot; other serving GPU processes stopped. No fixed-clock setting is recorded.
tp4.timing_semantics: Prepared full QSA transaction plus identical state restoration in both CUDA graphs; A/B/B/A order, fifteen samples per segment, thirty per arm. No output/state correctness failure is timed.
tp4.benchmark_formatting: Semicolon-separated statements expanded onto separate lines; AST identical to the executed script.

tp2.operating_mode: Single physical NVIDIA GB10 GPU in DGX Spark, P0 in every per-case before/after snapshot; other serving GPU processes stopped. No fixed-clock setting is recorded.
tp2.timing_semantics: Prepared full QSA transaction plus identical state restoration in both CUDA graphs; A/B/B/A order, fifteen samples per segment, thirty per arm. No output/state correctness failure is timed.
tp2.benchmark_formatting: Semicolon-separated statements expanded onto separate lines; AST identical to the executed script.

tp4_control.scope: Full-model serving; all measured batches are retained. Warmup batches are excluded.
tp4_control.command_origin: Reconstructed exactly from the committed-in-evidence driver.py run invocation; no separate command artifact was recorded.

correctness.component: Every recorded case verifies finite nonzero output, exact selected positions and persistent state, and allocation-free graph replay before timing.
correctness.coverage_limit: Bounded exact-answer checks do not establish general model quality. The initial TP4 arm did not complete the long-context checks.

serving_reproducer.adaptations: Workspace, output directory, and endpoint accept environment variables; the two prompt helpers are extracted verbatim; the separate post-performance shared-prefix subprocess is omitted. HTTP requests, token checks, timings, cache salts, warmups, and measured workload order are unchanged.

prompt_helper_source.state: Modified worktree; the two used functions and three constants are preserved verbatim in prompt_helpers.py.
